symbols.name: fixed exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed number below 1, the exponent in the cost bound $O(Vu^{\tau})$.
symbols.quote: The letter $\tau$ changes meaning here: it is this fixed exponent, below 1.

symbols.name: first field block
symbols.meaning: The bits of the first of the two address fields, read as a block at matching positions.
symbols.quote: Let $x$ and $y$ be the two fields, each read as a block of bits at matching positions; these letters change meaning here.

symbols.name: second field block
symbols.meaning: The bits of the second of the two address fields, read as a block at matching positions.
symbols.quote: Let $x$ and $y$ be the two fields, each read as a block of bits at matching positions; these letters change meaning here.

symbols.name: pieces per level
symbols.meaning: A fixed integer at least 2, the number of pieces each field is cut into at each level.
symbols.quote: Let $m\ge 2$ be a fixed integer, the number of pieces each field is cut into; this letter changes meaning here.

symbols.name: level count
symbols.meaning: The number of levels of the recursion, the logarithm to base m of the field width u.
symbols.quote: Take $u=m^k$, so the recursion has $k$ levels, where $k=\log_m u$ counts them; this letter changes meaning here too.

symbols.name: smaller calls
symbols.meaning: The number of smaller calls one call makes, equal to the sum of the edge ranks.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the number of smaller calls one call makes; this letter changes meaning here.

symbols.name: time per unit volume
symbols.meaning: The time per unit volume of a call on width $m^j$, bounded by the recurrence above.
symbols.quote: Let $\vartheta_j$ be the time per unit volume of a call on width $m^j$, the level $j$; the letter $j$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: level index
symbols.meaning: The level of a call, so a call on width $m^j$ sits at level $j$.
symbols.quote: Let $\vartheta_j$ be the time per unit volume of a call on width $m^j$, the level $j$; the letter $j$ changes meaning here.

relations.quote: The procedure runs on the [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md) with a fixed number of one-dimensional tapes.
The interchange is carried out by a [Linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md) network.
The network thus [restores its scratch storage](scratch-storage.md) to its starting contents, whatever they were.
